production.note: US model years 2022-2024. Start: MotorWeek's road test of the '2022 Rivian R1T' ('Motor Setup: Quad-Motor'). Last: Car and Driver's specifications for the 2024 R1T include the 'Adventure Quad-Motor Large Pack' (caranddriver-r1t-2024-specs, read by the project owner on 8 October 2026 (the site blocks the research tools)), and Edmunds' 2024 R1T lists 'Adventure 4dr Crew Cab AWD SB w/Quad-Motor, Large Pack' (edmunds-r1t-2024). For 2025 the Gen 2 Quad-Motor was re-rated: Motor1 (Chris Perkins, 6 June 2024): "The quad-motor powertrain gets a bump from 835 hp to 1,025 hp" (motor1-r1-2025-updates). No Rivian page giving the years was opened.

body.note: Edmunds: 'Adventure 4dr Crew Cab AWD SB w/Quad-Motor, Large Pack'. Crew cab, short bed, the only configuration.

configuration.note: Battery EV; MotorWeek: 'Quad-Motor', one motor 'for each wheel'.

drivetrain.note: Edmunds trim name 'AWD ... w/Quad-Motor'; MotorWeek: one motor 'for each wheel for true 4-wheel-drive' (no transfer case), so AWD under the data guide's rule.

transmission.note: Edmunds 2024 R1T: Quad-Motor trim marked '(electric DD)' (direct drive); drivetrain table 'Transmission: 1-speed direct drive' (shown for the default trim).

powerHp.note: PROVISIONAL (magazine specification section; no Rivian page opened). Car and Driver's specifications for the 2024 R1T, read by the project owner on 8 October 2026 (the site blocks the research tools): "2024 Rivian R1T Adventure Quad-Motor Large Pack": 835 hp. Agreeing: MotorWeek 2022 R1T specifications "Motor Setup: Quad-Motor", "Horsepower: 835", "Torque: 908 lb-ft" (motorweek-r1t-2022); Motor1 (2024): "The quad-motor powertrain gets a bump from 835 hp to 1,025 hp" (motor1-r1-2025-updates). Car and Driver's road-test panel for a 2022 R1T Launch Edition, also pasted by the owner, gives "Combined Power: 835 hp", "Combined Torque: 908 lb-ft". No Rivian press release or specification page stating 835 hp could be opened (rivian.com newsroom lists no Gen 1 Quad-Motor article).

weightLb.note: Car and Driver's specifications section for the 2024 R1T (the maker's figures, not a road-test measurement), read by the project owner on 8 October 2026 (the site blocks the research tools): "2024 Rivian R1T Adventure Quad-Motor Large Pack", curb weight 6,949 lb. Weight-order step 2 (major magazine specification panel). Tested weights of optioned trucks are higher: Car and Driver's road-test panel for a 2022 R1T Launch Edition (4 motors), pasted by the owner on 9 October 2026, "Curb Weight: 7173 lb" (tested; page link not supplied, so not entered as a source), and Edmunds' 7,148 lb (its test scale weight, see discrepancies). dimensions.com (6,949 lb) could not be opened (fetch error) and is not cited.

sources.title: 2024 Rivian R1T Review, Pricing, and Specs (specifications section)
The 2025 Rivian R1T and R1S Now Make Over 1,000 Horsepower (Chris Perkins, 6 June 2024)

discrepancies.reason: Specification vs other figures. Car and Driver's 6,949 lb is a specification curb weight for the 2024 Adventure Quad-Motor Large Pack. Edmunds' 2024 R1T page prints "Curb Weight | 7,148 lbs." for a different trim (shown for the default Dual-Motor, alongside 533 hp). Car and Driver's own road test of a 2022 Launch Edition measured 7,173 lb (owner-read; not entered as a source).
discrepancies.resolution: The specification-section curb weight (step 2) is used; 7,148 lb is printed for a different trim and 7,173 lb is a measured weight of an optioned test truck.

provisionalNote: Power (835 hp) rests on Car and Driver's specifications section (read by the project owner, 8 October 2026), agreed by MotorWeek and Motor1; no Rivian page stating the rating could be opened. A Rivian press release or specification page for the 2022-2024 Quad-Motor would replace it. Weight (6,949 lb) is a step-2 magazine specification figure and is not provisional. The model-year range rests on publications and Edmunds, not on a Rivian page.
